competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Institutional XRP custody and distribution access is expanding, but the new announcements do not yet establish material XRP spot demand or collateral deployment.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: No disclosed XRP custody balances, collateral balances, purchases or net institutional flows.
competing_hypotheses.test: Track BNY XRP custody product activation, client asset balances, XRP-specific collateral terms and exchange/custody flow data.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: RLUSD settlement can expand XRPL institutional activity without proportionate XRP spot demand because the announced settlement asset is RLUSD and XRP's network-fee/reserve role is small.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: XRP remains the native XRPL asset and may be used in DEX auto-bridging or other liquidity paths; transaction-level bridge volumes were not measured here.
competing_hypotheses.test: Measure XRPL RLUSD settlement, XRP fee burn, account-reserve demand, DEX auto-bridge volume and XRP order-book impact separately.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Coinbase is pursuing multi-issuer stablecoin distribution and monetization, retaining Circle economics while adding RLUSD and Arc access.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: USDC remains economically important; no evidence Circle's agreement is being reduced or terminated.
competing_hypotheses.test: Compare Coinbase stablecoin balances, revenue, distribution economics, trading volumes and collateral use by issuer over time.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Circle Arc is a competing institutional settlement/credit network to XRPL, while overlapping participants and multichain stablecoin distribution make the relationship partly complementary.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: Arc and XRPL can serve distinct applications; no evidence of direct displacement or head-to-head volume migration.
competing_hypotheses.test: Track Arc vs XRPL stablecoin settlement, collateral composition, institutional participants, liquidity and cross-chain transfer flows.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: SBI is pursuing a multi-rail strategy spanning Ripple/RLUSD, Circle/USDC/Arc, JPYSC/Startale and Open Standard rather than an exclusive XRP bet.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: SBI's decade-long Ripple relationship and RLUSD Japan distribution are direct, durable commitments.
competing_hypotheses.test: Track live SBI VC Trade network routes, JPYSC issuance/settlement, Arc validator operations, OUSD interoperability and XRP-related balances.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: C2FO Instant Pay could convert existing trade-finance demand into onchain RLUSD settlement, but the scale of actual capital on XRPL is still unknown.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: The $520B historical working-capital figure is not Instant Pay volume; the new product has a waitlist and no deployed-volume disclosure.
competing_hypotheses.test: Find C2FO supplier onboarding, participating capital-provider disclosures, invoices financed, XRPL settlement transactions and RLUSD flow attribution.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Short-term XRP price dynamics remain more directly observable through derivatives positioning, ETF flows and macro liquidity than through partnership headlines alone.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: Institutional announcements can alter expectations and later flows, but the timing and magnitude are not established.
competing_hypotheses.test: Use point-in-time event studies with pre-registered windows, controls, venue-normalized features and out-of-sample walk-forward tests.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Ripple's growing corporate revenue and transaction throughput may support ecosystem durability without directly accruing value to XRP holders.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: Some Ripple products may use XRP for liquidity/bridge functions, but product-level XRP usage and fee capture were not disclosed in the cited release.
competing_hypotheses.test: Reconcile product revenue, XRP inventory/flows, ODL/Payments bridge legs, XRP liquidity utilization, on-ledger fees and any direct token demand.

source_independence.coordinated_event_group: BNY/Ripple, C2FO/Ripple, Coinbase/Ripple and Ripple/Robinhood announcements cluster around Ripple Swell 2026 and must not be counted as fully independent causal shocks.
